#!/usr/bin/env bash
# S19 — independent test runner for souji-shokunin round 2 (tools/souji-verify.sh).
#
# Usage: bash harness.sh [tool-path] [fixtures-dir] [out-json]
# Defaults: <lane>/tools/souji-verify.sh, <lane>/tests/fixtures,
#           <lane>/tests/results/runner-19.json
#
# Read-only over the lane repo: copies shared fixtures into a mktemp dir
# before running them; writes only the runner JSON it was told to write.
set -euo pipefail

LANE="${SOUJI_LANE:-/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin}"
FLEET="${SOUJI_FLEET:-/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin}"
TOOL="${1:-$LANE/tools/souji-verify.sh}"
FIXDIR="${2:-$LANE/tests/fixtures}"
OUT="${3:-$LANE/tests/results/runner-19.json}"
HERE="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PY="${HERE}/harness.py"

export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="souji fixture"
export GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="souji@shokunin.local"
export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="souji fixture"
export GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="souji@shokunin.local"
export GIT_AUTHOR_DATE="2024-01-01T00:00:00+0000"
export GIT_COMMITTER_DATE="2024-01-01T00:00:00+0000"

SNAP="$(mktemp -d /tmp/souji-runner-19.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$SNAP"' EXIT
OBS="$SNAP/observations.tsv"; : >"$OBS"
META="$SNAP/meta.tsv"; : >"$META"

meta() { printf '%s\t%s\n' "$1" "${2//$'\t'/ }" >>"$META"; }
# check <status> <case> <target> <expected> <observed> <detail>
check() { printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4" "$5" "${6//$'\t'/ }" >>"$OBS"; }

run_capture() { # run_capture <outfile> <errfile> <cmd...> ; sets RC
  local outf="$1" errf="$2"; shift 2
  set +e
  "$@" >"$outf" 2>"$errf"
  RC=$?
  set -e
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- metadata --
meta runner S19
meta round 2
meta started_utc "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
meta lane "$LANE"
meta fleet_root "$FLEET"
meta fixtures_dir "$FIXDIR"
meta bash_version "$(bash --version | head -1)"
meta git_version "$(git --version)"
meta rg_path "$(command -v rg || echo missing)"
meta rg_version "$(rg --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo missing)"
meta python3_version "$(python3 --version 2>&1)"
meta runner_host "$(uname -srm)"

if [ -f "$TOOL" ]; then
  meta tool_present 1
  meta tool_path "$TOOL"
  meta tool_sha256 "$(sha256sum "$TOOL" | awk '{print $1}')"
  meta tool_bytes "$(stat -c %s "$TOOL")"
  meta tool_mtime_utc "$(stat -c %y "$TOOL" | cut -d. -f1)"
else
  meta tool_present 0
  meta tool_path "$TOOL"
  meta tool_sha256 ""
fi
meta harness_sha256 "$(sha256sum "$HERE/harness.sh" "$PY" | awk '{printf "%s ", $1}')"

if [ ! -f "$TOOL" ]; then
  check TOOL-ABSENT selftest - "exec & exit0 on F1-F10" "-" "tool not found: $TOOL"
  python3 "$PY" report --obs "$OBS" --meta "$META" --harness-sh "$HERE/harness.sh" \
    --harness-py "$PY" --out "$OUT" --verdict TOOL-ABSENT
  echo "runner-19: TOOL-ABSENT ($TOOL) -> $OUT" >&2
  exit 1
fi

SNAPTOOL="$SNAP/tool-snapshot.sh"
cp "$TOOL" "$SNAPTOOL"; chmod +x "$SNAPTOOL"
meta snapshot_sha256 "$(sha256sum "$SNAPTOOL" | awk '{print $1}')"

# ------------------------------------------------------- suite: CLI/usage --
set +e; bash "$SNAPTOOL" >"$SNAP/noargs.out" 2>"$SNAP/noargs.err"; RC=$?; set -e
if [ "$RC" -eq 2 ]; then S=PASS; else S=FAIL; fi
check "$S" cli "no-args" "exit 2 (usage)" "exit $RC" "stdout+stderr: $(head -c 200 "$SNAP/noargs.out" "$SNAP/noargs.err" | tr '\n' ' ')"
meta usage_noargs_rc "$RC"

MISSING_TGT="$SNAP/definitely-absent-target"
run_capture "$SNAP/missing.out" "$SNAP/missing.err" bash "$SNAPTOOL" "$MISSING_TGT"
L="$(python3 "$PY" line "$SNAP/missing.out" "$MISSING_TGT" || true)"
V="$(printf '%s' "$L" | cut -f2)"; R="$(printf '%s' "$L" | cut -f3)"
if [ "$RC" -eq 0 ] && [ "$V" = "NOT-SAFE" ] && [ "$R" = "unreachable" ]; then S=PASS; else S=FAIL; fi
check "$S" cli "missing-target" "exit0, NOT-SAFE/unreachable" "exit $RC, ${V:-<none>}/${R:-<none>}" "raw: $L"
meta missing_target_rc "$RC"

# ------------------------------------------------------------- suite: selftest
run_capture "$SNAP/selftest.out" "$SNAP/selftest.err" bash "$SNAPTOOL" --selftest
meta selftest_rc "$RC"
meta selftest_tail "$(tail -c 400 "$SNAP/selftest.out" | tr '\n' ' ')"
meta selftest_err_tail "$(tail -c 200 "$SNAP/selftest.err" | tr '\n' ' ')"
if [ "$RC" -eq 0 ]; then S=PASS; else S=FAIL; fi
check "$S" selftest "--selftest" "exit 0, all F1-F10 pass" "exit $RC" "$(tail -n 3 "$SNAP/selftest.out" | tr '\n' ' ')"

# ----------------------------------------------------- suite: shared fixtures
# heterogeneous per-seat schemas (F1 targets+expect, F3 souji-verify-fixture/1,
# F4 ${CASE_ROOT} + env, F7 relative target, F10 targets[].expected + canaries)
# are adapted in harness.py; cases run in a case-local copy under $SNAP.
python3 "$PY" shared --fixtures "$FIXDIR" --tool "$SNAPTOOL" --obs "$OBS" --meta "$META" \
  --scratch "$SNAP/shared"

# ------------------------------------------------ suite: independent fixtures
FIXROOT="$SNAP/fixroot"
mkdir -p "$FIXROOT" "$SNAP/work" "$SNAP/vault"
git -c init.defaultBranch=master init -q "$FIXROOT"
( cd "$FIXROOT" && printf 'fleet root\n' >README.md && git add README.md && git -c user.name=souji -c user.email=souji@shokunin.local commit -qm "fixture fleet root" )
# fixture ledger, in every plausible resolution root (after the clones below)
LEDGER_ROW_PATH="$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin/notes/exported-note.md"
mkdir -p "$SNAP/vault"

# seed origin bare repo + clones
git init -q -b master "$SNAP/work/seed"
( cd "$SNAP/work/seed" && printf 'base\n' >base.txt && git add base.txt && git -c user.name=souji -c user.email=souji@shokunin.local commit -qm base )
git clone -q --bare "$SNAP/work/seed" "$FIXROOT/origin.git"
git clone -q "$FIXROOT/origin.git" "$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin" 2>/dev/null || {
  rm -rf "$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin"; git clone -q "$FIXROOT/origin.git" "$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin"; }
mkdir -p "$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin/notes" "$FIXROOT/souji-shokunin/corpus/knowledge" \
  "$FIXROOT/corpus/knowledge" "$SNAP/corpus/knowledge"
printf 'note kept only in the vault\n' >"$LEDGER_ROW_PATH"
printf 'vault copy of the note\n' >"$SNAP/vault/exported-note.md"
SRC_SHA="$(sha256sum "$LEDGER_ROW_PATH" | awk '{print $1}')"
VAULT_SHA="$(sha256sum "$SNAP/vault/exported-note.md" | awk '{print $1}')"
ledger_body="$(printf 'source_path\tsource_sha256\tvault_path\tvault_sha256\texported_at\tnote\n%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
  "$LEDGER_ROW_PATH" "$SRC_SHA" "$SNAP/vault/exported-note.md" "$VAULT_SHA" "2024-06-01" "fixture row")"
printf '%s' "$ledger_body" >"$FIXROOT/souji-shokunin/corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv"
printf '%s' "$ledger_body" >"$FIXROOT/corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv"
printf '%s' "$ledger_body" >"$SNAP/corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv"
# alpha: F1 pushed file, F2 local-only file
( cd "$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin"
  git checkout -q master 2>/dev/null || true
  printf 'pushed payload\n' >pushed.txt
  git add pushed.txt; git commit -qm "add pushed.txt"
  git push -q origin master
  printf 'local only\n' >local-only.txt
  git add local-only.txt; git commit -qm "add local-only.txt"
  printf 'scratch output\n' >scratch-a.out
  printf 'scratch output b\n' >scratch-b.out
  mkdir -p .scratch; printf 'old dump\n' >.scratch/old-dump.out
  touch -d '3 days ago' .scratch/old-dump.out scratch-a.out scratch-b.out
  printf 'placeholder not a real credential\n' >config.env
)
# census-like reference for F8 (only the D3-exempt, spec-named location)
mkdir -p "$FIXROOT/souji-shokunin/census/round-2"
printf '{"candidate":"scratch-b.out"}\n' >"$FIXROOT/souji-shokunin/census/round-2/seat-98.json"
# beta: F3 kotodama-shaped repo root (2 unpushed commits, dirty)
git clone -q "$FIXROOT/origin.git" "$FIXROOT/beta-shokunin"
( cd "$FIXROOT/beta-shokunin"
  printf 'b1\n' >b1.txt; git add b1.txt; git commit -qm "b1"
  printf 'b2\n' >b2.txt; git add b2.txt; git commit -qm "b2"
  printf 'dirty edit\n' >>base.txt
)
# gamma: F4 metadata-prune (absent dir, unique=0), F5 unpushed branch worktree
git clone -q "$FIXROOT/origin.git" "$FIXROOT/gamma-shokunin"
git -C "$FIXROOT/gamma-shokunin" worktree add -q --detach "$SNAP/wt-gone" HEAD
rm -rf "$SNAP/wt-gone"
git -C "$FIXROOT/gamma-shokunin" worktree add -q -b wt-r99 "$SNAP/wt-live" HEAD
( cd "$SNAP/wt-live" && printf 'worktree commit\n' >wt.txt && git add wt.txt && git -c user.name=souji -c user.email=souji@shokunin.local commit -qm "wt-r99 work" )

# fixture preconditions (guards against harness bugs)
if git -C "$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin" merge-base --is-ancestor \
     "$(git -C "$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin" log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -1 -- pushed.txt)" \
     refs/remotes/origin/master; then S=PASS; else S=FAIL; fi
check "$S" preconditions "F1: pushed.txt introducer ancestor of origin/master" "ancestor" "checked" ""
unp="$(git -C "$FIXROOT/beta-shokunin" log --branches --not --remotes --oneline | wc -l)"
dirty="$(git -C "$FIXROOT/beta-shokunin" status --porcelain | wc -l)"
if [ "$unp" -eq 2 ] && [ "$dirty" -eq 1 ]; then S=PASS; else S=FAIL; fi
check "$S" preconditions "F3: beta unpushed=2 dirty=1" "unpushed=2 dirty=1" "unpushed=$unp dirty=$dirty" ""
wthead="$(git -C "$FIXROOT/gamma-shokunin" rev-parse HEAD)"
uniq="$(git -C "$FIXROOT/gamma-shokunin" log --oneline "$wthead" --not --all | wc -l)"
if [ ! -d "$SNAP/wt-gone" ] && [ "$uniq" -eq 0 ]; then S=PASS; else S=FAIL; fi
check "$S" preconditions "F4: wt-gone absent and unique=0" "absent, unique=0" "dir=$([ -d "$SNAP/wt-gone" ] && echo present || echo absent) unique=$uniq" ""
unpbr="$(git -C "$FIXROOT/gamma-shokunin" log --oneline wt-r99 --not --remotes | wc -l)"
if [ "$unpbr" -eq 1 ]; then S=PASS; else S=FAIL; fi
check "$S" preconditions "F5: wt-r99 unpushed=1" "unpushed=1" "unpushed=$unpbr" ""

ind_run() { # ind_run <outfile> <args...>
  local outf="$1"; shift
  run_capture "$outf" "$outf.err" env SHOKUNIN_ROOT="$FIXROOT" bash "$SNAPTOOL" "$@"
}

f1t="$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin/pushed.txt"
ind_run "$SNAP/ind1.out" "$f1t" "$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin/local-only.txt" "$FIXROOT/beta-shokunin" \
        "$SNAP/wt-gone" "$SNAP/wt-live" "$LEDGER_ROW_PATH" "$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin/.scratch/old-dump.out" \
        "$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin/scratch-a.out" "$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin/scratch-b.out" \
        "$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin/config.env"
rc_run=$RC; meta independent_rc "$rc_run"

emit_ind() { # emit_ind <case> <target> <expected-args...>
  local c="$1" tgt="$2"; shift 2
  local L J S EX DET
  L="$(python3 "$PY" line "$SNAP/ind1.out" "$tgt" || true)"
  J="$(python3 "$PY" judge "$@" --observed "$L" 2>&1 || true)"
  S="$(printf '%s' "$J" | cut -f1)"; EX="$(printf '%s' "$J" | cut -f2)"; DET="$(printf '%s' "$J" | cut -f3)"
  check "$S" "$c" "$tgt" "$EX" "$(printf '%s' "$L" | cut -f2,3 | tr '\t' '/')" "$DET"
}

emit_ind F1 "$f1t" --verdict-set SAFE --receipt-set pushed
emit_ind F2 "$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin/local-only.txt" --verdict-set NOT-SAFE --receipt-set none,pushed-unverifiable
emit_ind F3 "$FIXROOT/beta-shokunin" --verdict-set NOT-SAFE --evidence-regex 'unpushed=2'
emit_ind F4 "$SNAP/wt-gone" --verdict-set SAFE --receipt-set metadata-prune
emit_ind F5 "$SNAP/wt-live" --verdict-set NOT-SAFE --receipt-set unpushed-branch
emit_ind F6 "$LEDGER_ROW_PATH" --verdict-set SAFE --receipt-set moved-to-obsidian
emit_ind F7 "$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin/.scratch/old-dump.out" --verdict-set SAFE --receipt-set stale
emit_ind F8 "$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin/scratch-b.out" --verdict-set SAFE --receipt-set stale
emit_ind F10 "$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin/config.env" --verdict-set NOT-SAFE --receipt-set secrets-refusal
# F3 evidence detail: also record the unpushed/dirty numbers verbatim
L3="$(python3 "$PY" line "$SNAP/ind1.out" "$FIXROOT/beta-shokunin" || true)"
meta f3_evidence "$(printf '%s' "$L3" | cut -f4)"

# stale-days threshold: same file, --stale-days 3 must flip to NOT-SAFE
run_capture "$SNAP/ind2.out" "$SNAP/ind2.err" env SHOKUNIN_ROOT="$FIXROOT" bash "$SNAPTOOL" --stale-days 3 \
  "$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin/.scratch/old-dump.out"
L="$(python3 "$PY" line "$SNAP/ind2.out" "$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin/.scratch/old-dump.out" || true)"
J="$(python3 "$PY" judge --verdict-set NOT-SAFE --receipt-set none --observed "$L" 2>&1 || true)"
S="$(printf '%s' "$J" | cut -f1)"; EX="$(printf '%s' "$J" | cut -f2)"; DET="$(printf '%s' "$J" | cut -f3)"
check "$S" stale-days "$FIXROOT/alpha-shokunin/.scratch/old-dump.out" "$EX" "$(printf '%s' "$L" | cut -f2,3 | tr '\t' '/')" "$DET"
# --json must parse and exit 0
run_capture "$SNAP/ind3.out" "$SNAP/ind3.err" env SHOKUNIN_ROOT="$FIXROOT" bash "$SNAPTOOL" --json "$f1t"
if [ "$RC" -eq 0 ] && python3 -c 'import json,sys;json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))' "$SNAP/ind3.out" 2>/dev/null; then S=PASS; else S=FAIL; fi
check "$S" json --json "exit0 and valid JSON" "exit $RC, $(head -c 80 "$SNAP/ind3.out" | tr '\n' ' ')" ""

# --------------------------------------------------------------- suite: live
if [ -d "$FLEET/kotodama-shokunin" ]; then
  run_capture "$SNAP/live.out" "$SNAP/live.err" bash "$TOOL" "$FLEET/kotodama-shokunin"
  meta live_kotodama_rc "$RC"
  L="$(python3 "$PY" line "$SNAP/live.out" "$FLEET/kotodama-shokunin" || true)"
  V="$(printf '%s' "$L" | cut -f2)"; R="$(printf '%s' "$L" | cut -f3)"
  if [ "$V" = "NOT-SAFE" ] && [ "$R" != "secrets-refusal" ]; then S=PASS; else S=FAIL; fi
  check "$S" live "kotodama-shokunin" "NOT-SAFE (unpushed/dirty repo root)" "${V:-<none>}/${R:-<none>}" "raw: $L"
  meta live_kotodama_raw "$L"
else
  check NOT-EXERCISED live "$FLEET/kotodama-shokunin" "dir present" "absent" ""
fi
# live sanity: a pushed tracked file in the lane repo (spec-precondition derived)
if [ "$(git -C "$LANE" log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -1 -- AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l)" -ge 1 ]; then
  DB="$(git -C "$LANE" symbolic-ref --quiet --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's@^origin/@@' || true)"
  if [ -z "$DB" ]; then
    n_origin="$(git -C "$LANE" for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' refs/remotes/origin 2>/dev/null | grep -c . || true)"
    if [ "$n_origin" -eq 1 ]; then DB="$(git -C "$LANE" for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' refs/remotes/origin | sed 's@^origin/@@')"; fi
  fi
  if [ -z "$DB" ] && git -C "$LANE" show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/master; then DB=master; fi
  if [ -n "$DB" ]; then
    ic="$(git -C "$LANE" log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -1 -- AGENTS.md)"
    if git -C "$LANE" merge-base --is-ancestor "$ic" "$DB"; then
      run_capture "$SNAP/live2.out" "$SNAP/live2.err" bash "$TOOL" "$LANE/AGENTS.md"
      L="$(python3 "$PY" line "$SNAP/live2.out" "$LANE/AGENTS.md" || true)"
      J="$(python3 "$PY" judge --verdict-set SAFE --receipt-set pushed --observed "$L" 2>&1 || true)"
      S="$(printf '%s' "$J" | cut -f1)"; EX="$(printf '%s' "$J" | cut -f2)"; DET="$(printf '%s' "$J" | cut -f3)"
      check "$S" live "lane/AGENTS.md (pushed precursor)" "$EX" "$(printf '%s' "$L" | cut -f2,3 | tr '\t' '/')" "$DET"
    fi
    meta live_default_branch_resolved "$DB"
  else
    meta live_default_branch_resolved unresolvable
  fi
fi

# --------------------------------------------------------------- report -----
python3 "$PY" report --obs "$OBS" --meta "$META" --harness-sh "$HERE/harness.sh" \
  --harness-py "$PY" --out "$OUT" --verdict "$(python3 "$PY" verdict "$OBS")"
echo "runner-19: wrote $OUT" >&2
python3 - "$OUT" <<'PYEOF'
import json,sys
d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
s=d["summary"]
print(f'runner-19 verdict={d["verdict"]} checks={s["checks"]} pass={s["pass"]} fail={s["fail"]} not_exercised={s["not_exercised"]}')
PYEOF
[ "$(python3 "$PY" verdict "$OBS")" = "PASS" ]
